record.question: What exact segment traversal connects each remaining published Lassen trailhead and destination, including shared junctions and alternatives?
record.reason: Wayproof publishes complete, bidirectional, distance-bearing trailhead-to-summit graphs for Lassen Peak and Brokeoff Mountain, a connected distance-bearing parking-to-basin-entry graph for Bumpass Hell, and the atomic shared approach plus around-lake network for Boiling Springs Lake. It also publishes ordered, bidirectional Warner Valley topology for Devils Kitchen and Terminal Geyser, but atomic leg distances remain unknown where route descriptions print only cumulative positions. Cinder Cone, the full Bumpass basin circulation, the Kings Creek alternative, and remaining shared Warner Valley corridors still require route-specific reconciliation before being described as complete visitor traversals.
